resources.string: Bring back the one-tap Do Not Disturb toggle in your Quick Settings panel.
Allow this app to control its Do Not Disturb modes. Optional quiet places also need location access.
Swipe down from the top of your screen to open Quick Settings, tap the edit (pencil) icon, then drag the \"Do Not Disturb\" tile into your panel.
The tile works with the app closed. It controls this app\'s modes; other Android modes can keep DND on. Turning the tile off pauses active quiet places until you leave.
Choose the icon that looks best on your home screen.
